headwords: cháy nhà mới ra mặt chuột

flags.why: This everyday name for a mouse is Southern usage, as recorded in the [Huế dialect dictionary](https://www.art2all.net/chantran/chantran_tho/tranngocbao/tudienphuongnguhue/tudienphuongnguhue_C.htm).
The example needs bị to express naturally that the person gets a cramp.
flags.fix: Anh ấy đang chạy thì bị chuột rút. = He got a cramp while running.

flags.why: The example defines the animal instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Một con chuột xạ chạy vào bụi cỏ. = A musk shrew ran into a clump of grass.

flags.why: The word describes spreading the legs apart, whereas bow-leggedness describes curved legs.
flags.fix: with the legs spread wide apart

flags.why: This sense means remaining nearby rather than nagging or pestering, as recorded in the [Vietnamese dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ch%C3%A0ng%20r%C3%A0ng).
flags.fix: to keep hanging around beside someone

flags.headword: cháy nhà mới ra mặt chuột
flags.why: The literal image underlying the proverb is not a separate meaning used to describe rats escaping a fire.
